description.zh: 连接模式 (PrivateLink: PrivateLink, OverlayLink: 基于ANSM的overlayLink)
description.en: The connection mode. Valid values: \`PrivateLink\` and \`OverlayLink\`. \`OverlayLink\` is an overlay link based on Application-aware Network Service Mesh (ANSM).

description.zh: 正/反向私网访问 (Forward: 正向访问, Reverse: 反向访问)
description.en: The direction of the internal-facing access. Valid values: \`Forward\` and \`Reverse\`.
The ID of the region where the service is located.
The zone for the service deployment.

descriptions.zh:
### 前提条件
请先确认服务商在创建服务时开启变配功能并完成变配参数设置。
descriptions.en:
### Prerequisites

Ensure that the service provider enabled the upgrade/downgrade feature and set the related parameters when the service was created.
